title: Wallāh il-ʿaẓīm, it wasn't me!
goal: At the office, Maryam asks who took the cake for today's party; deny it firmly, then help her work out where it went
grammar: strong denial: an oath, mub ana, ḥatta ma + verb, ma … ay ḥad, māli dakhal
tip: Stack your negatives for a firm denial: an oath (wallāh il-ʿaẓīm, aḥlif-lich), the denial (ma lamast-ha), then 'not even' with ḥatta ma + verb (ḥatta ma fataḥt ith-thallāja). Inside a negative, 'anyone' is ay ḥad. Close with māli dakhal 'it's nothing to do with me'.
dialogue: A
يا ويلي! وين الكيكة اللي كانت في الثلاجة؟ هذي حق حفلة اليوم!
yā wēli! wēn il-kēka illi kānat fi th-thallāja? hādhi ḥagg ḥaflat il-yōm!
Oh no! Where's the cake that was in the fridge? It's for today's party!
B
مب أنا! والله العظيم ما لمستها
mub ana! wallāh il-ʿaẓīm ma lamast-ha
It wasn't me! I swear to God I didn't touch it.
A
من جدك؟ بس انت آخر واحد كان في المطبخ الصبح
min jiddak? bas inta ākhir wāḥid kān fi l-maṭbakh iṣ-ṣubḥ
Seriously? But you were the last one in the kitchen this morning.
B
كنت أسوي قهوة بس. حتى ما فتحت الثلاجة!
kint asawwi gahwa bas. ḥatta ma fataḥt ith-thallāja!
I was only making coffee. I didn't even open the fridge!
A
عيل منو خذها؟ ما شفت أي حد يفتح الثلاجة؟
ʿayal minu khadhha? ma shift ay ḥad yiftaḥ ith-thallāja?
Then who took it? Didn't you see anyone open the fridge?
B
لا والله، أحلف لج، ما شفت أي حد. وأنا مالي دخل
la wallāh, aḥlif-lich, ma shift ay ḥad. w ana māli dakhal
No, honestly, I swear to you, I didn't see anyone. And it's nothing to do with me.
A
زين، انت بريء لين يطلع الدليل! والمثل يقول: لا تبوق لا تخاف
zēn, inta barīʼ lēn yiṭlaʿ id-dalīl! w il-mathal ygūl: la tbūg la tkhāf
OK, you're innocent until the evidence turns up! As the saying goes: if you don't steal, you've nothing to fear.
B
يمكن حد حطها في ثلاجة غرفة الاجتماعات؟
yimkin ḥad ḥaṭṭha fi thallājat ghurfat il-ijtimāʿāt?
Maybe someone put it in the meeting-room fridge?
A
شوف! هني هي، الحمد لله. السموحة، شكيت فيك وظلمتك
shūf! hni hiya, il-ḥamdu lillāh. is-samūḥa, shakkēt fīk w ẓalamtak
Look! Here it is, thank God. Sorry, I suspected you and I was unfair to you.
B
ما عليه. بس قلت لج: مالي دخل!
ma ʿalēh. bas gilt-lich: māli dakhal!
No problem. But I told you: nothing to do with me!
items: a masculine thing: ma lamastah (ما لمسته)
it's nothing to do with me, it's none of my business
I wronged you, I was unfair to you (to a man)
if you don't steal, you've nothing to fear (a saying)

title: Neither fixed nor phoned
goal: At a karak stand, tell your classmate Mājid the garage has had your car a week and done nothing, and decide what to do next
tip: 'Neither … nor' is la … wala: la hādha wala hādha 'neither one'. It also joins two clauses, la ḥad yrudd, wala ḥad ygūl shay 'nobody answers or tells me anything', and two nouns in set phrases: la ḥiss wala khabar 'not a word from them'.
dialogue: A
شو صار على سيارتك؟ صلحوها في الورشة؟
shu ṣār ʿala sayyārtak? ṣallaḥōha fi l-warsha?
What's happening with your car? Have they fixed it at the garage?
B
لا صلحوها ولا اتصلوا! صار لي أسبوع
la ṣallaḥōha wala ittaṣlaw! ṣār-li usbūʿ
They haven't fixed it or even called! It's been a week.
A
عيل دق عليهم انت
ʿayal digg ʿalēhum inta
Then you ring them.
B
لا حد يرد، ولا حد يقول شي. مليت!
la ḥad yrudd, wala ḥad ygūl shay. malēt!
Nobody answers, and nobody tells me anything. I'm fed up!
A
لا حس ولا خبر يعني؟ والفاتورة بتكون صدمة! شو فيها السيارة؟
la ḥiss wala khabar yaʿni? w il-fātūra bitkūn ṣadma! shu fīha s-sayyāra?
Not a word, then? And the bill will be a shock! What's wrong with the car?
B
الفرامل والقير. وما عندي وقت، ولا عندي صبر
il-farāmil w il-gēr. w ma ʿindi wagt, wala ʿindi ṣabir
The brakes and the gearbox. And I haven't got the time, or the patience.
A
وانت من غير سيارة، لا رحت ولا ييت. بس شد حيلك
w inta min ghēr sayyāra, la riḥt wala yīt. bas shidd ḥēlak
And without a car, you haven't been anywhere. But hang in there.
B
بالضبط. حتى الجامعة أروح لها بالتاكسي
biẓ-ẓabṭ. ḥatta l-jāmʿa arūḥ-lha bit-tāksi
Exactly. Even uni, I go by taxi.
A
مب سالفة، مب أول مرة تصير. بتعطيهم وقت ولّا بتاخذها ورشة ثانية؟
mub sālfa, mub awwal marra tṣīr. bitʿaṭīhum wagt walla bitākhidhha warsha thānya?
It's no big deal; it's not the first time this has happened. Will you give them time, or take it to another garage?
B
لا هذا ولا هذا. بروح لهم باكر الصبح
la hādha wala hādha. barūḥ-lhum bāchir iṣ-ṣubḥ
Neither. I'll go and see them tomorrow morning.
items: not a word, no news at all (lit. no sound and no news)

title: We only see you at Eid!
goal: In Bū Rāshid's majlis, take his teasing about how rarely you visit, and talk about Rāshid, who thinks of nothing but football
grammar: 'only' as ma … illa (nothing but, no one but)
tip: Gulf says 'only' as 'not … except': ma … illa. ma baga illa l-imtiḥānāt 'only the exams are left'; ma yfakkir illa fi l-kūra 'he thinks of nothing but football'. Elders use it to tease: ma nshūfak illa fi l-aʿyād 'we only see you at Eid'.
dialogue: A
هلا والله بسالم! ما نشوفك إلا في الأعياد يا ولدي
hala wallāh b-Sālim! ma nshūfak illa fi l-aʿyād yā wildi
Well, hello, Sālim! We only ever see you at Eid, son.
B
هلا بك يا عمي! السموحة، الشغل والدراسة ما خلوا لي وقت
hala bik yā ʿammi! is-samūḥa, ish-shughul w id-dirāsa ma khallaw-li wagt
Hello, uncle! Forgive me; work and studies haven't left me any time.
A
مسموح يا ولدي، الله يرضى عليك. وشحال الدراسة؟
masmūḥ yā wildi, allāh yirẓa ʿalēk. w shḥāl id-dirāsa?
No need, son, God bless you. And how are your studies?
B
ما بقى إلا الامتحانات. وراشد شحاله؟
ma baga illa l-imtiḥānāt. w Rāshid shḥālah?
Only the exams are left. And how's Rāshid?
A
راشد؟ ما يفكر إلا في الكورة. كل يوم في التمارين، ويقول بيلعب في المنتخب!
Rāshid? ma yfakkir illa fi l-kūra. kill yōm fi t-tamārīn, w ygūl biyilʿab fi l-muntakhab!
Rāshid? He thinks of nothing but football. He's at training every day, and says he'll play for the national team!
B
بس امتحاناته قريبة. ما يذاكر أبد؟
bas imtiḥānātah garība. ma ydhākir abad?
But his exams are soon. Doesn't he study at all?
A
لا حس ولا خبر عن الكتب! وآخر نتايجه كانت صدمة
la ḥiss wala khabar ʿan il-kutub! w ākhir natāyjah kānat ṣadma
No sign of the books! And his last results were a shock.
B
بس هو عنيد! ما يسمع إلا من سيف
bas huwa ʿanīd! ma yismaʿ illa min Sēf
But he's stubborn! He listens to no one but Sēf.
A
هيه، وراسه يابس، والغلط مني، هو مدلع. بس يقولون: ما يفل الحديد إلا الحديد
hē, w rāsah yābis, w il-ghalaṭ minni, huwa mdallaʿ. bas ygūlūn: ma yfill il-ḥadīd illa l-ḥadīd
Yes, he's pig-headed; and it's my fault, he's spoilt. But as they say, only iron cuts iron.
B
يعني ما يقدر عليه إلا سيف، حتى وهو برا!
yaʿni ma yigdar ʿalēh illa Sēf, ḥatta w huwa barra!
So only Sēf can handle him, even from abroad!
items: he's pig-headed (lit. his head is dry)
only iron cuts iron (it takes a tough one to handle a tough one) (a saying)

title: Never seen a camel race
goal: Outside the majlis, Rāshid invites you to the camel races with his dad; admit you've never been, and agree to an early start
grammar: negative concord: ma … ay, wala marra, maḥḥad + verb
tip: In a negative sentence every 'any' word stays negative: ma aʿarf ay shay ʿanha 'I don't know anything about them', maḥḥad biyitmaṣkhar ʿalēk 'no one will make fun of you', wala marra 'not once'. For 'there's no need to', Emirati says mub lāzim + verb: mub lāzim taʿarf shay.
dialogue: A
أبوي بيروح سباق الهجن يوم الجمعة، وما عندي تمرين. تبي تيي ويانا؟
ubūy biyrūḥ sibāg il-hijin yōm il-jumʿa, w ma ʿindi tamrīn. tabi tiyi wiyyāna?
My dad's going to the camel races on Friday, and I haven't got training. Do you want to come with us?
B
أكيد! عمري ما شفت ولا سباق
akīd! ʿumri ma shift wala sibāg
Definitely! I've never seen a single race in my life.
A
صج؟ ولا مرة؟ ترا اللي يركب الهجن الحين روبوت!
ṣij? wala marra? tara illi yirkab il-hijin il-ḥīn rōbōt!
Really? Not once? You know, it's robots that ride the camels now!
B
صج؟ ما أعرف أي شي عنها!
ṣij? ma aʿarf ay shay ʿanha!
Really? I don't know anything about them!
A
مب سالفة. مب لازم تعرف شي. يحركونه بالريموت من السيارة
mub sālfa. mub lāzim taʿarf shay. yḥarrkūnah bir-rīmōt min is-sayyāra
No big deal. You don't need to know anything. They control it by remote from the car.
B
بالريموت؟ من جدك؟ بس ما أعرف أي حد هناك
bir-rīmōt? min jiddak? bas ma aʿarf ay ḥad hnāk
By remote? Seriously? But I don't know anyone there.
A
لا تخاف، محد بيتمصخر عليك. وأبوي يعرف كل الناس هناك
la tkhāf, maḥḥad biyitmaṣkhar ʿalēk. w ubūy yaʿarf kill in-nās hnāk
Don't worry, nobody's going to make fun of you. And my dad knows everyone there.
B
زين، ما عندي مانع. وفي جمهور وايد؟
zēn, ma ʿindi māniʿ. w fī jamhūr wāyid?
OK, I don't mind. And is there a big crowd?
A
هيه، وقبل الفجر برد. البس فروة، انت قدها؟
hē, w gabil il-fajr bard. ilbis farwa, inta gadd-ha?
Yes, and before dawn it's cold. Wear a farwa. Are you up to it?
B
قدها! وبكون جاهز من الساعة أربع
gadd-ha! w bakūn jāhiz min is-sāʿa arbaʿ
I'm up to it! And I'll be ready from four.
items: nobody will make fun of you: maḥḥad biyitmaṣkhar ʿalēk
a farwa (a long winter coat lined with fleece)
culture: Camel racing is a winter sport in the UAE: the season runs from about October to April, with races early in the morning at tracks such as Al Marmoom near Dubai. Child jockeys are banned, and today the camels carry small remote-controlled robot jockeys, steered by trainers who drive alongside the track in 4x4s.

title: Dream on, Rāshid!
goal: Outside the majlis, Rāshid (17) begs to drive your car 'just once round the block'; refuse firmly, with humour, and don't give in
grammar: strong refusal: mustaḥīl, la tiḥlam, ḥatta lō + verb … ma, la la
tip: Refuse with a stack: mustaḥīl, then la tiḥlam 'dream on', then 'even if' with ḥatta lō: ḥatta lō tʿaṭīni malyōn, ma baʿṭīk il-miftāḥ. Back it with a reason: w lō daʿamt? 'and what if you crashed?'. Keep la tiḥlam for friends and younger people.
dialogue: A
برو، عطني مفتاح سيارتك! بس لفة وحدة حول المجلس
brō, ʿaṭni miftāḥ sayyārtak! bas laffa waḥda ḥōl il-majlis
Bro, give me your car key! Just one spin round the majlis.
B
من جدك؟ مستحيل! انت ما عندك رخصة
min jiddak? mustaḥīl! inta ma ʿindak rukhṣa
Are you serious? No way! You haven't got a licence.
A
مب سالفة! مب لازم رخصة حق لفة، وأنا بحط البنزين
mub sālfa! mub lāzim rukhṣa ḥagg laffa, w ana baḥuṭṭ il-banzīn
No big deal! You don't need a licence for a spin, and I'll put the petrol in.
B
لا تحلم. حتى لو تعطيني مليون، ما بعطيك المفتاح
la tiḥlam. ḥatta lō tʿaṭīni malyōn, ma baʿṭīk il-miftāḥ
Dream on. Even if you gave me a million, I wouldn't give you the key.
A
حرام عليك! محد بيدري، ومب مثل الشباب اللي يفحطون
ḥarām ʿalēk! maḥḥad biyidri, w mub mithil ish-shabāb illi yfaḥḥiṭūn
Come on, that's mean! Nobody'll know, and I'm not like the guys who do drifting.
B
ولو دعمت؟ أبوك بيقول إني مستهتر، وبيذبحني!
w lō daʿamt? ubūk biygūl inni mistahtir, w biyidhbaḥni!
And if you crashed? Your dad would say I'm reckless, and he'd kill me!
A
ما بدعم! بلبس الحزام، وبسوق شوي شوي
ma badʿam! balbis il-ḥizām, w basūg shwayy shwayy
I won't crash! I'll wear the seatbelt, and I'll drive slowly.
B
لا لا، السيارة مب لعبة بالريموت! وخطر عليك، لا تتهور
la la, is-sayyāra mub liʿba bir-rīmōt! w khaṭar ʿalēk, la tit-hawwar
No, no, a car isn't a remote-control toy! And it's dangerous for you; don't be rash.
A
زين، بس يوم ألعب في المنتخب وأطلع الرخصة، أول سيارة بسوقها سيارتك!
zēn, bas yōm alʿab fi l-muntakhab w aṭallaʿ ir-rukhṣa, awwal sayyāra basūg-ha sayyārtak!
Fine, but when I play for the national team and get my licence, the first car I drive will be yours!
B
يصير خير! بس مب قبل
yṣīr khēr! bas mub gabil
We'll see! But not before.
items: I crashed (into something); you crashed (to a man)
don't be rash, don't do anything reckless (to a man)
to a woman: la tit-hawwarīn (لا تتهورين)
they drift, they spin their cars (youth)
task: This week: with a tutor or exchange partner (search a tutoring site for «Emirati Arabic tutor»), talk for 10 minutes. First tell them about three things you've never done (ʿumri ma…, wala marra). Then ask them to accuse you, as a joke, of something; deny it firmly (wallāh il-ʿaẓīm, mub ana, māli dakhal) and refuse what they ask (la tiḥlam, ḥatta lō…).

title: Whoever wins, I'm with them!
goal: At university, your classmate Khalfān is organising a five-a-side game for Thursday night; sort out who plays, who pays and whose team you're on
grammar: free relatives: illi 'whoever, whatever', shu ma / wēn ma 'whatever, wherever'
tip: illi with no noun before it means 'whoever' or 'whatever': illi yfūz 'whoever wins', illi ʿindah 'whatever he's got', maʿa illi tabi 'with whoever you like'. shu ma and wēn ma make 'whatever, wherever': shu ma ṣār 'whatever happens', wēn ma ḥaṭṭētak 'wherever I put you'.
dialogue: A
الخميس بنلعب كورة في الملعب اللي يم الجامعة. تبي تلعب؟
il-khamīs binilʿab kūra fi l-malʿab illi yamm il-jāmʿa. tabi tilʿab?
On Thursday we're playing football at the pitch next to the university. Do you want to play?
B
أكيد! تمرين ولّا مباراة؟ وفي جمهور؟
akīd! tamrīn walla mubārā? w fī jamhūr?
Sure! Training or a match? And will there be a crowd?
A
اللي يبي ييي، ييي. بس اللي يتأخر يدفع حق الملعب!
illi yabi yiyi, yiyi. bas illi yitʼakhkhar yidfaʿ ḥagg il-malʿab!
Whoever wants to come can come. But whoever's late pays for the pitch!
B
شو ما صار، أنا بكون هناك قبل الساعة ثمان
shu ma ṣār, ana bakūn hnāk gabil is-sāʿa thamān
Whatever happens, I'll be there before eight.
A
وكل واحد يلبس اللي عنده، مب سالفة. مب لازم تشتري فانيلة
w kill wāḥid yilbis illi ʿindah, mub sālfa. mub lāzim tishtiri fānēla
And everyone wears whatever they've got; it's no big deal. No need to buy a shirt.
B
زين، ما عندي مانع. وأنا في أي فريق؟
zēn, ma ʿindi māniʿ. w ana fi ay farīg?
Fine, I don't mind. And which team am I on?
A
مع اللي تبي. بس تذكر: أنا الكابتن، والتشكيلة علي!
maʿa illi tabi. bas tdhakkar: ana l-kābtin, w it-tashkīla ʿalay!
With whoever you like. But remember: I'm the captain, and the line-up is down to me!
B
بلعب مع اللي يفوز!
balʿab maʿa illi yfūz!
I'll play with whoever wins!
A
من جدك؟ ما يصير جي! وين ما حطيتك تلعب، ولّا احتياط
min jiddak? ma yṣīr chī! wēn ma ḥaṭṭētak tilʿab, walla iḥtiyāṭ
Are you serious? You can't do that! You play wherever I put you, or you're on the bench.
B
خلاص، اللي تشوفه يا خلفان
khalāṣ, illi tshūfah yā Khalfān
Fine, whatever you say, Khalfān.

title: Weren't you the one who said 'leave it to me'?
goal: On Thursday evening, Khalfān admits he forgot to book the pitch; tell him off, as a friend, and let him put it right
grammar: reproaching: mub inta illi …?, khadhaltni, faẓīḥa; non-restrictive illi (huwa)
tip: Reproach a friend with a question: mub inta illi gilt 'khallha ʿalay'? 'weren't you the one who said leave it to me?', then name it: khadhaltni 'you've let me down', faẓīḥa! 'what a disgrace!'. You'll also hear illi huwa adding a fact: wild ʿammi, illi huwa yishtaghil fi nādi.
dialogue: A
يا ريّال، الملعب محجوز! ما في مكان الليلة
yā rayyāl, il-malʿab maḥjūz! ma fī makān il-lēla
Mate, the pitch is booked! There's no slot tonight.
B
شلون محجوز؟ مب انت اللي قلت خلها علي؟
shlōn maḥjūz? mub inta illi gilt khallha ʿalay?
What do you mean, booked? Weren't you the one who said 'leave it to me'?
A
هيه... بس نسيت أحجز. السموحة
hē… bas nisēt aḥjiz. is-samūḥa
Yes… but I forgot to book. Sorry.
B
فضيحة! تورطنا! والشباب بعضهم ياي من الشارقة، والحين في الطريق
faẓīḥa! twarraṭna! w ish-shabāb baʿaẓhum yāy min ish-Shārja, w il-ḥīn fi ṭ-ṭarīg
What a disgrace! We're in a fix! And some of the guys are coming from Sharjah, and they're on their way now.
A
أدري، الغلط مني. شو أقول؟ الشرهة علي
adri, il-ghalaṭ minni. shu agūl? ish-sharha ʿalay
I know, it's my fault. What can I say? The blame's on me.
B
خذلتني يا خلفان. مب انت اللي عندك خطة؟
khadhaltni yā Khalfān. mub inta illi ʿindak khiṭṭa?
You've let me down, Khalfān. Weren't you the one with a plan?
A
خلاص، بتصرف. بدق على ولد عمي، اللي هو يشتغل في نادي
khalāṣ, batṣarraf. badigg ʿala wild ʿammi, illi huwa yishtaghil fi nādi
OK, I'll sort it out. I'll ring my cousin, who works at a club.
B
هذا إهمال يا خلفان! الحجز مسؤوليتك، لا تكون مستهتر هالمرة
hādha ihmāl yā Khalfān! il-ḥajiz masʼūliyytak, la tkūn mistahtir hal-marra
That's sloppy, Khalfān! The booking was your responsibility; don't be careless this time.
A
أبشر، يصير خير. والعشا الليلة على اللي يفوز!
abshir, yṣīr khēr. w il-ʿasha l-lēla ʿala illi yfūz!
Consider it done; it'll be fine. And tonight's dinner is on whoever wins!
B
ما عليه. عندي فانيلة، والمهم نلعب
ma ʿalēh. ʿindi fānēla, w il-muhimm nilʿab
Never mind. I've got a shirt, and what matters is that we play.
items: you've let me down (to a man)
we're in a fix, we're stuck (lit. we got entangled)
I'll sort it out, I'll deal with it
the blame's on me, it's my fault

title: I wonder what they'll ask
goal: At the office, Maryam tells you that you're presenting to the client tomorrow; say how nervous you are, and get her help to prepare
grammar: embedded questions: ma aʿarf shu / min wēn …, yā tara shu …
tip: Put a question inside a sentence with no change of word order: ma aʿarf min wēn abda 'I don't know where to start'; taʿarfīn minu biykūn min ʿind-hum? 'do you know who'll be there from their side?'. yā tara + question is 'I wonder…': yā tara shu biyisʼalūn?
dialogue: A
المدير يبيك تقدم العرض حق العميل باكر
il-mudīr yabīk tgaddim il-ʿarẓ ḥagg il-ʿamīl bāchir
The manager wants you to give the presentation to the client tomorrow.
B
أنا؟ أتوتر وايد قدام العميل!
ana? atwattar wāyid jiddām il-ʿamīl!
Me? I get really nervous in front of clients!
A
ليش؟ مب سالفة! انت تعرف المشروع أحسن من أي حد
lēsh? mub sālfa! inta taʿarf il-mashrūʿ aḥsan min ay ḥad
Why? It's no big deal! You know the project better than anyone.
B
يا ترا شو بيسألون؟ ما أعرف من وين أبدا
yā tara shu biyisʼalūn? ma aʿarf min wēn abda
I wonder what they'll ask? I don't know where to start.
A
وين الشجاعة؟ بنسوي خطة، وبتصرف وياك لو صار شي
wēn ish-shajāʿa? binsawwi khiṭṭa, w batṣarraf wiyyāk lō ṣār shay
Where's your courage? We'll make a plan, and I'll handle it with you if anything comes up.
B
بس أنا مرتبك. وإذا تلخبطت قدامهم؟ فضيحة!
bas ana mirtabik. w idha tlakhbaṭt jiddāmhum? faẓīḥa!
But I'm flustered. And what if I get muddled in front of them? How embarrassing!
A
عشان جي نسوي بروفة الحين على البروجكتر. وإذا ما تعرف شي، قول: بنرد عليكم
ʿashān chī nsawwi brōva l-ḥīn ʿala l-brōjektar. w idha ma taʿarf shay, gūl: binrudd ʿalēkum
That's why we'll do a run-through now on the projector. And if you don't know something, say: we'll get back to you.
B
فكرة حلوة. تعرفين منو بيكون من عندهم؟
fikra ḥilwa. taʿarfīn minu biykūn min ʿind-hum?
Good idea. Do you know who'll be there from their side?
A
ما أدري بالضبط، بس أظن المديرة حقهم بنفسها، وجمهور كامل!
ma adri biẓ-ẓabṭ, bas aẓunn il-mudīra ḥagg-hum b-nafs-ha, w jamhūr kāmil!
I don't know exactly, but I think their manager herself, and a whole audience!
B
الله يستر! تورطنا. خلينا نبدا الحين
allāh yistur! twarraṭna. khallīna nibda l-ḥīn
Heaven help me! We're in for it. Let's start now.
items: I got muddled, I got confused
to a man: tlakhbaṭt (you got muddled); to a woman: tlakhbaṭti (تلخبطتي)

title: Who says you need a degree?
goal: In the majlis, Rāshid says he'll skip university and become a YouTuber; argue with him using questions, and find a middle way
grammar: rhetorical questions in an argument: minu gāl inn…?, shu l-fāyda min…?, wēn il-mushkila?
tip: Argue with questions that don't want an answer: minu gāl inn…? 'who says…?', shu l-fāyda min…? 'what's the point of…?', wēn il-mushkila? 'where's the problem?'. A question can also push back gently: lēsh tikhtār? 'why choose?'
dialogue: A
ليش أدرس أربع سنين؟ أبي أصير مؤثر، يوتيوبر وبس
lēsh adris arbaʿ sinīn? abi aṣīr muʼaththir, yūtyūbar w bas
Why study for four years? I just want to be an influencer, a YouTuber.
B
والبرمجة؟ مب انت اللي تبي تدرس برمجة؟
w il-barmaja? mub inta illi tabi tidris barmaja?
And programming? Weren't you the one who wanted to study programming?
A
شو الفايدة من الشهادة؟ في ناس عندهم ملايين المتابعين بدون جامعة
shu l-fāyda min ish-shahāda? fī nās ʿind-hum malāyīn il-mutābiʿīn bidūn jāmʿa
What's the point of a degree? There are people with millions of followers and no university.
B
ومنو قال إن المؤثر ما يباله شهادة؟ وكم واحد منهم؟
w minu gāl inn il-muʼaththir ma yabā-lah shahāda? w cham wāḥid minhum?
And who says an influencer doesn't need a degree? And how many of them are there?
A
وين المشكلة؟ أجرب، وإذا ما نفع، بتصرف وأدرس
wēn il-mushkila? ajarrib, w idha ma nifaʿ, batṣarraf w adris
Where's the problem? I'll try, and if it doesn't work out, I'll sort something out and study.
B
وإذا ما نفع؟ فضيحة! لازم يكون عندك خطة
w idha ma nifaʿ? faẓīḥa! lāzim ykūn ʿindak khiṭṭa
And if it doesn't work out? How embarrassing! You need a plan.
A
أنا مب مرتبك. عندي كاميرا، والمحتوى في راسي
ana mub mirtabik. ʿindi kāmīra, w il-muḥtawa fi rāsi
I'm not nervous. I've got a camera, and the content's in my head.
B
صح، بس الظروف تتغير. ليش تختار؟ تقدر تسوي الثنتين
ṣaḥḥ, bas iẓ-ẓurūf titghayyar. lēsh tikhtār? tigdar tsawwi th-thintēn
True, but circumstances change. Why choose? You can do both.
A
يعني أدرس وأصور مع بعض؟ والمونتاج بالليل؟ والله فكرة
yaʿni adris w aṣawwir maʿa baʿaẓ? w il-mōntāj bil-lēl? wallāh fikra
You mean study and film at the same time? And edit at night? That's an idea.
B
أكيد! وأول فيديو: يوم في حياة طالب جامعة!
akīd! w awwal fīdyō: yōm fi ḥayāt ṭālib jāmʿa!
Of course! And your first video: a day in the life of a uni student!
culture: In the UAE, people who promote products or services on social media now need an 'advertiser permit' from the UAE Media Council, introduced in 2025. So being a YouTuber as a job means paperwork as well as filming.

title: Shu hal-jamāl! Kayaking in Hatta
goal: On a winter trip to Hatta with your classmate Mājid, marvel at the lake and the mountains, and admit you should have come before
grammar: exclamatives: shu hal-…!, tuḥfa!; recycle: shkuthur, yā salām, subḥān allāh
tip: Marvel with shu hal- + noun: shu hal-jamāl! 'how beautiful!'. One word can do it too: tuḥfa! 'gorgeous!'. Old friends come back: shkuthur il-māy ṣāfi!, yā salām!, and ma twaggaʿt inn… 'I didn't expect…': ma twaggaʿt inn Ḥatta b-hal-ḥalāwa.
dialogue: A
شوف الماي! شو هالجمال! صور، وصير مؤثر!
shūf il-māy! shu hal-jamāl! ṣawwir, w ṣīr muʼaththir!
Look at the water! How beautiful! Take a picture, and be an influencer!
B
سبحان الله! ما توقعت إن حتا بهالحلاوة
subḥān allāh! ma twaggaʿt inn Ḥatta b-hal-ḥalāwa
Amazing! I didn't expect Hatta to be this lovely.
A
وشكثر الماي صافي! تقدر تشوف الصخر تحت
w shkuthur il-māy ṣāfi! tigdar tshūf iṣ-ṣakhar taḥt
And the water's so clear! You can see the rocks underneath.
B
يا سلام! والجبال حوالينا، تحفة!
yā salām! w il-jibāl ḥawālēna, tuḥfa!
Wow! And the mountains all around us, gorgeous!
A
قلت لك! ولا أروع من حتا في الشتا
gilt-lak! wala arwaʿ min Ḥatta fi sh-shita
I told you! Nothing beats Hatta in winter.
B
والهوا بارد. مب مثل دبي!
w il-hawa bārid. mub mithil Dbayy!
And the air's cool. Not like Dubai!
A
يلا، الكاياك مب خطر، وسهل. خلنا نروح لين آخر السد
yalla, il-kāyāk mub khaṭar, w sahl. khallna nrūḥ lēn ākhir is-sadd
Come on, the kayak isn't dangerous, and it's easy. Let's go to the far end of the dam.
B
يا ترا ليش ما ييت هني من قبل؟ فاتني وايد!
yā tara lēsh ma yīt hni min gabil? fātni wāyid!
Why didn't I come here before, I wonder? I've missed out on so much!
A
لأنك كل ويكند في المول، فضيحة!
lann-ak kill wīkind fi l-mōl, faẓīḥa!
Because you're at the mall every weekend, it's a disgrace!
B
خلاص، شو الفايدة من المول؟ من اليوم بس جبال!
khalāṣ, shu l-fāyda min il-mōl? min il-yōm bas jibāl!
Right, what's the point of the mall? From today, just mountains!
items: how beautiful! (lit. what is this beauty)
culture: Hatta is a mountain town in the Hajar Mountains, part of the emirate of Dubai, about 130 km east of the city near the border with Oman. Visitors go there for the hiking trails and to kayak on the lake behind Hatta Dam.
task: This week: search YouTube for «رحلة حتا» or «يومياتي في حتا» (a Hatta trip vlog) and watch 10 minutes. Within a minute you should hear شو / مب; if you hear سوف or ليس all the time, pick another clip. Note every exclamation (shu hal-…, subḥān allāh, yā salām). Then record a 2-minute voice note to Sēf describing a place that amazed you.

title: Even though I was nervous
goal: At the office, Maryam tells you the client has approved the project; admit what went wrong in your presentation, and hear why it worked anyway
grammar: concessives: maʿa inni, w lō innhum, w maʿa hādha, ṣaḥḥ innah … bas, raghm, mahma kān
tip: Concede, then turn: maʿa inni kint mirtabik 'even though I was flustered'; w lō innhum shāfōha 'even though they saw them'. Turn with w maʿa hādha 'and yet' or bas. ṣaḥḥ innah … bas … admits a point first; mahma kān 'whatever happened' closes it.
dialogue: A
مبروك! العميل وافق على المشروع
mabrūk! il-ʿamīl wāfag ʿala l-mashrūʿ
Congratulations! The client has approved the project.
B
الله يبارك فيج! مع إني كنت مرتبك وايد
allāh ybārik fīch! maʿa inni kint mirtabik wāyid
Thank you! Even though I was really flustered.
A
ومع هذا، العرض كان تحفة. صح تلخبطت شوي، بس البروفة فادت
w maʿa hādha, il-ʿarẓ kān tuḥfa. ṣaḥḥ tlakhbaṭt shwayy, bas il-brōva fādat
And yet the presentation was superb. True, you got a bit muddled, but the run-through paid off.
B
صح إنه كان في أغلاط، بس ما انتبهوا
ṣaḥḥ innah kān fī aghlāṭ, bas ma intabhaw
It's true there were mistakes, but they didn't notice.
A
لا، انتبهوا! بس ولو إنهم شافوها، انبهروا بالفكرة
la, intabhaw! bas w lō innhum shāfōha, inbiharaw bil-fikra
Oh, they noticed! But even though they saw them, they were impressed by the idea.
B
يعني رغم الأغلاط وافقوا؟ ما توقعت إن هذا يصير!
yaʿni raghm il-aghlāṭ wāfgaw? ma twaggaʿt inn hādha yṣīr!
So they approved it despite the mistakes? I didn't expect that to happen!
A
هيه. منو قال إن العرض لازم يكون بدون ولا غلطة؟ الفكرة كانت مقنعة
hē. minu gāl inn il-ʿarẓ lāzim ykūn bidūn wala ghalṭa? il-fikra kānat mugniʿa
Yes. Who says a presentation has to be without a single mistake? The idea was convincing.
B
مهما كان، المرة الياية بكون أحسن
mahma kān, il-marra l-yāya bakūn aḥsan
Whatever happened, next time I'll be better.
A
أكيد. وجرأتك في الأسئلة كانت حلوة، والفريق كله فخور بك
akīd. w jurʼatak fi l-asʼila kānat ḥilwa, w il-farīg killah fakhūr bik
Of course. And your nerve with the questions was great, and the whole team is proud of you.
B
مشكورة يا مريم، شو أقول؟ من غير مساعدتج ما قدرت
mashkūra yā Maryam, shu agūl? min ghēr musāʿadtich ma gidart
Thank you, Maryam; what can I say? I couldn't have done it without your help.
items: anyway, whatever the case, no matter what
convincing (a feminine noun, such as an idea)
your nerve, your boldness (to a man)
they were impressed, they were amazed
to a woman: fakhūr bich (فخور بج); (recognise)

title: OK, you beat me. I admit it
goal: At Bū Rāshid's house in Sharjah, Rāshid beats you at football on the PlayStation; admit he played better, but get your own point in
grammar: conceding: aʿtarif, ma agūl la, bas…; recycle: maʿa inni, ʿala kill ḥāl
tip: Concede in steps: say it (zēn, ghalabtni), admit it (aʿtarif), then add your point with bas: ma agūl la, bas… 'I won't say no, but…'. Push back with mub ʿudhur! 'it's not an excuse!' and close with ʿala kill ḥāl 'anyway'.
dialogue: A
خمسة ثلاثة! فضيحة! قلت لك ما تقدر علي
khamsa thalātha! faẓīḥa! gilt-lak ma tigdar ʿalay
Five three! What a thrashing! I told you you couldn't handle me.
B
زين، غلبتني. أعترف
zēn, ghalabtni. aʿtarif
OK, you beat me. I admit it.
A
وتعترف إني أحسن منك؟
w tiʿtarif inni aḥsan minnak?
And you admit I'm better than you?
B
ما أقول لا، بس انت تغش! عيني عينك!
ma agūl la, bas inta tghishsh! ʿēni ʿēnak!
I won't say no, but you cheat! Right in front of me!
A
كل مرة نفس العذر! ما ركزت، الجويستك خربان، النت بطيء
kill marra nafs il-ʿudhur! ma rakkazt, il-jōystik kharbān, in-nit baṭīʼ
The same excuse every time! I wasn't focused, the controller's broken, the internet's slow.
B
مب عذر! مهما كان، لعبت زين في الشوط الثاني
mub ʿudhur! mahma kān, liʿabt zēn fi sh-shōṭ ith-thāni
It's not an excuse! Anyway, I played well in the second half.
A
صح، أعترف إن الهدف الثالث حقك كان تحفة
ṣaḥḥ, aʿtarif inn il-hadaf ith-thālith ḥaggak kān tuḥfa
True, I admit your third goal was a beauty.
B
على كل حال، المرة الياية بنتقم!
ʿala kill ḥāl, il-marra l-yāya bantagim!
Anyway, next time I'll get my revenge!
A
إن شاء الله! بس لين ذاك اليوم، أنا البطل. جولة ثانية؟
in shāʼ allāh! bas lēn dhāk il-yōm, ana l-baṭal. jōla thānya?
God willing! But until that day, I'm the champion. Another round?
B
لا تبالغ! يلا، جولة ثانية
la tbālig! yalla, jōla thānya
Don't get carried away! Go on, another round.
items: an excuse: ʿudhur (عذر); the same excuse: nafs il-ʿudhur
right in front of me, openly (lit. my eye, your eye)
I'll get my revenge, I'll get you back

title: I mean ten, not twenty
goal: In the team meeting, give Maryam and the team this month's sales figures, catch your own slip, and say it again more clearly
grammar: repair: agṣid, khallni agūlha b-ṭarīga thānya, zallat lisān
tip: Correct yourself at once with la, agṣid… 'no, I mean…'. For a slip, say zallat lisān. If people don't follow, start again: khallni agūlha b-ṭarīga thānya 'let me put it another way'. gaṣdi inn… 'what I mean is…' explains.
dialogue: A
يلا، عطنا أرقام المبيعات حق هالشهر
yalla, ʿaṭna argām il-mabīʿāt ḥagg hash-shahar
Go on, give us this month's sales figures.
B
زادت عشرين بالمية... لا، أقصد عشرة
zādat ʿishrīn bil-miya… la, agṣid ʿashra
They went up twenty per cent… no, I mean ten.
A
عشرة ولّا عشرين؟ في فرق!
ʿashra walla ʿishrīn? fī farg!
Ten or twenty? There's a difference!
B
السموحة، زلة لسان. أتلخبط مع الأرقام!
is-samūḥa, zallat lisān. atlakhbaṭ maʿa l-argām!
Sorry, a slip of the tongue. I get muddled with figures!
A
ما عليه. الأرقام مقنعة. بس ليش هالشهر أحسن من اللي قبله؟
ma ʿalēh. il-argām mugniʿa. bas lēsh hash-shahar aḥsan min illi gablah?
No problem. The figures are convincing. But why is this month better than the one before?
B
عشان الخصم... لا، خلني أقولها بطريقة ثانية: الناس اشتروا أكثر لأن الأسعار نزلت
ʿashān il-khaṣim… la, khallni agūlha b-ṭarīga thānya: in-nās ishtaraw akthar lann il-asʿār nizlat
Because of the discount… no, let me put it another way: people bought more because prices came down.
A
يعني الخصم هو السبب؟ والميزانية؟ وشو صار في المخزون؟
yaʿni l-khaṣim huwa s-sabab? w il-mīzāniyya? w shu ṣār fi l-makhzūn?
So the discount is the reason? And the budget? And what happened to the stock?
B
مب بس. قصدي إن الخصم ساعد، بس مب هو السبب الوحيد
mub bas. gaṣdi inn il-khaṣim sāʿad, bas mub huwa s-sabab il-waḥīd
Not only. What I mean is that the discount helped, but it isn't the only reason.
A
صح إنه ساعد. بس رغم النمو، لازم نشوف الأرقام بدون الخصم
ṣaḥḥ innah sāʿad. bas raghm in-numuw, lāzim nshūf il-argām bidūn il-khaṣim
True, it helped. But despite the growth, we need to see the figures without the discount.
B
بالضبط. مهما كان، بطرش لج التفاصيل بعد الاجتماع
biẓ-ẓabṭ. mahma kān, baṭarrish-lich it-tafāṣīl baʿd il-ijtimāʿ
Exactly. Whatever the case, I'll send you the details after the meeting.
items: the stock (in a shop or warehouse)

title: Between you and me, Fahad
goal: On a call with Fahad, now that the company has offered you a graduate job, tell him, just between you, that you're staying; your mum doesn't know yet
grammar: parentheticals: bēni w bēnak, ʿala ḥasab ʿilmi, la samaḥ allāh, allāh yiḥfaẓ- after naming a parent
tip: Asides go in the middle of a sentence: bas, bēni w bēnak, bagʿid… 'but, between you and me, I'm staying…'. la samaḥ allāh 'God forbid' softens a bad thought. After naming a parent, add a blessing: ummi, allāh yiḥfaẓha, … 'my mum, God keep her, …'.
dialogue: A
هلا والله! شلونك؟ شنو أخبار دبي؟
hala wallāh! shlōnak? shinu akhbār Dbayy?
Hey! How are you? What's the news from Dubai?
B
هلا فيك! كل شي زين. بس بيني وبينك، بقعد في دبي بعد التخرج
hala fīk! kill shay zēn. bas bēni w bēnak, bagʿid fi Dbayy baʿd it-takharruj
Hi! All good. But between you and me, I'm staying in Dubai after I graduate.
A
صج؟ يعني قبلت الوظيفة اللي عرضوها عليك؟ وأهلك يدرون؟
ṣij? yaʿni gibalt il-waẓīfa illi ʿaraẓōha ʿalēk? w ahlak yadrūn?
Really? So you've accepted the job they offered you? Does your family know?
B
للحين لا. وأمي، الله يحفظها، بتزعل
lil-ḥīn la. w ummi, allāh yiḥfaẓha, bitizʿal
Not yet. And my mum, God keep her, will be upset.
A
طبيعي، كل الأمهات جذي. على ما يبدو قلبها كبير
ṭabīʿi, kill il-ummahāt chidhi. ʿala ma yibdu galbha kbīr
That's normal; all mums are like that. It seems she's got a big heart.
B
هيه، وعلى حسب علمي، الراتب بيزيد بعد سنة
hē, w ʿala ḥasab ʿilmi, ir-rātib biyzīd baʿd sana
Yes, and as far as I know, the salary goes up after a year.
A
خوش! مهما كان، هذي فرصتك، تحفة! ومع احترامي لأمك، لا تفوتها
khōsh! mahma kān, hādhi furṣtak, tuḥfa! w maʿa iḥtirāmi l-ummak, la tfawwit-ha
Great! Whatever the case, this is your chance, and a great one! And with all respect to your mum, don't miss it.
B
أدري. بس هي عاطفية، وأنا مرتبك
adri. bas hiya ʿāṭifiyya, w ana mirtabik
I know. But she's emotional, and I'm nervous.
A
الحق ينقال، صعب، ومشاعرها غالية. بس كلمها بنفسك، مو بالواتساب
il-ḥagg yingāl, ṣaʿb, w mashāʿirha ghālya. bas kallimha b-nafsak, mū bil-wātsāb
Truth be told, it is hard, and her feelings matter. But talk to her yourself, not on WhatsApp.
B
فكرة زينة. ولا سمح الله لو زعلت، حضن كبير!
fikra zēna. w la samaḥ allāh lō ziʿlat, ḥuẓun kbīr!
Good idea. And if, God forbid, she's upset, a big hug!

title: Staying? Staying.
goal: On a video call from abroad, Sēf fires quick questions about your decision to stay in Dubai; answer him in short replies, the way friends do
grammar: ellipsis and short replies: answering with one word or phrase, leaving out what's known
tip: Between friends, leave out what you both know. Answer with the key word: bitigʿid walla bitirjaʿ? — bagʿid. Answer a 'when' with just the time: il-wīkind. One or two words can carry a whole answer: la, fīdyō; dumūʿ, akīd.
dialogue: A
ها؟ قررت؟ بتقعد ولّا بترجع لندن؟
hā? garrart? bitigʿid walla bitirjaʿ Landan?
So? Have you decided? Are you staying, or going back to London?
B
بقعد، إن شاء الله
bagʿid, in shāʼ allāh
Staying, God willing.
A
صج؟ وأهلك؟
ṣij? w ahlak?
Really? And your family?
B
للحين ما قلت لهم. الويكند. مضطر
lil-ḥīn ma gilt-lhum. il-wīkind. muẓṭarr
I haven't told them yet. At the weekend. I have to.
A
بس جي؟ بالتلفون؟
bas chī? bit-tilifōn?
Just like that? On the phone?
B
لا، فيديو. وأخوي الكبير ويانا، يواسيها
la, fīdyō. w akhūy il-kbīr wiyyāna, ywāsīha
No, video. With my eldest brother on too, to comfort her.
A
صدقني، أمك عاطفية. لا سمح الله، بتبكي؟
ṣaddigni, ummak ʿāṭifiyya. la samaḥ allāh, bitibchi?
Believe me, your mum's emotional. God forbid, will she cry?
B
دموع، أكيد. بس بتتعود، مهما كان
dumūʿ, akīd. bas bititʿawwad, mahma kān
Tears, for sure. But she'll get used to it, whatever happens.
A
مغامرة! وأنا؟ يوم أرجع، بتعزمني على كرك كل يوم؟
mughāmara! w ana? yōm arjaʿ, bitʿazimni ʿala karak kill yōm?
Quite an adventure! And me? When I'm back, will you buy me a karak every day?
B
كل يوم؟ لا. كل خميس، يمكن. يصير خير
kill yōm? la. kill khamīs, yimkin. yṣīr khēr
Every day? No. Every Thursday, maybe. We'll see.
items: she'll cry; you'll cry (to a man)
I have to, I've no choice (a man)
task: This week: with a tutor or exchange partner (search a tutoring site for «Emirati Arabic tutor»), talk for 10 minutes about a decision you've made. Ask them to fire short questions at you, and answer in one or two words where you can (bagʿid, il-wīkind, shwayy, akīd). Slip in one aside (bēni w bēnak, ṣaddigni) and correct yourself once on purpose (la, agṣid…).

title: Checkpoint 5.2: Fahad's call
goal: Checkpoint: Fahad phones from Kuwait to tease you about Rāshid, the car and your news; deny, reproach, concede and correct yourself
grammar: checkpoint 5.2 (s5u016–s5u030): denials, la … wala, ma … illa, reproach, concessives, repair, short replies
tip: Use the block together: deny firmly (wallāh il-ʿaẓīm, mub ana, la miftāḥ wala sayyāra), concede with ṣaḥḥ innah … bas, repair with la, agṣid, and finish with ma … illa. Fahad's Kuwaiti forms are for recognising: shinu, mū and ēh.
dialogue: A
سمعت إنك عطيت راشد سيارتك؟ فضيحة! شنو هالحركة؟
simaʿt innak ʿaṭēt Rāshid sayyārtak? faẓīḥa! shinu hal-ḥaraka?
I heard you gave Rāshid your car? Scandal! What was that about?
B
مب أنا! والله العظيم، لا مفتاح ولا سيارة! مالي دخل
mub ana! wallāh il-ʿaẓīm, la miftāḥ wala sayyāra! māli dakhal
Not me! I swear to God: no key, no car! It's nothing to do with me.
A
زين زين، ما يحتاج تحلف. راشد اللي قال لي، وهو ما يكذب ولا يألف من عنده
zēn zēn, ma yiḥtāj tiḥlif. Rāshid illi gāl-li, w huwa ma yichdhib wala yiʼallif min ʿindah
OK, OK, no need to swear. It was Rāshid who told me, and he doesn't lie or make things up.
B
راشد؟ مب هو اللي ترجاني وقلت له لا؟ والحين يتهمني؟ هالشيطان!
Rāshid? mub huwa illi trajjāni w gilt-lah la? w il-ḥīn yittihimni? hash-shēṭān!
Rāshid? Wasn't he the one who begged me and I said no? And now he's accusing me? The little devil!
A
أنا مالي شغل بينكم. بس سمعت إنه غلبك في البلايستيشن بعد
ana māli shughul bēnkum. bas simaʿt innah ghalabak fi l-blēstēshin baʿad
It's none of my business between you two. But I heard he beat you on the PlayStation too.
B
صح إنه غلبني، بس مب عذر، كان يغش!
ṣaḥḥ innah ghalabni, bas mub ʿudhur, kān yghishsh!
It's true he beat me, but that's no excuse; he was cheating!
A
إيه، كل واحد يقول جذي، بس مو عذر مقنع. وشنو قررت؟ بتقعد؟
ēh, kill wāḥid ygūl chidhi, bas mū ʿudhur mugniʿ. w shinu garrart? bitigʿid?
Yeah, everyone says that, but it's not a convincing excuse. And what have you decided? Are you staying?
B
بقعد، مضطر… لا، أقصد، أبي أقعد!
bagʿid, muẓṭarr… la, agṣid, abi agʿid!
Staying; I have to… no, I mean, I want to stay!
A
يعني ما بقى إلا تقول لأمك؟ مو سالفة ملفقة؟
yaʿni ma baga illa tgūl l-ummak? mū sālfa mlaffaga?
So the only thing left is to tell your mum? It's not a made-up story?
B
بالضبط. بيني وبينك، ما يخوفني إلا هي!
biẓ-ẓabṭ. bēni w bēnak, ma ykhawwifni illa hiya!
Exactly. Between you and me, nothing scares me but her!
items: you're accusing me: tittihimni (to a man), tittihimīni (to a woman)
he makes things up (lit. he composes from himself)
